messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Claims handlers must upload documents one at a time because bulk upload is unavailable or unreliable. This slows down claim processing and wastes time on repetitive tasks.",
 "similar": [
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4127",
   "similarity": 0.143,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-10-06T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Users can now upload multiple documents at once to a claim in Keelwater, streamlining the process and reducing manual effort for claims handlers.\", \"id\": 4127, \"name\": \"Bulk upload documents to a claim\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4135",
   "similarity": 0.058,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater's claim information display provides a clear, real-time overview of active claims, including status, assigned adjuster, and key dates, helping users stay informed without switching screens.\", \"id\": 4135, \"name\": \"Claim information display\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4134",
   "similarity": 0.057,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater is enhancing its task list interface to improve user efficiency, allowing for better prioritization, drag-and-drop reordering, and real-time status updates—all designed to streamline claims processing workflows.\", \"id\": 4134, \"name\": \"Task list improvements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },
  {
   "source": "notion",
   "id": "6c413d61-b72b-5cf2-9349-34ba54498719",
   "similarity": 0.054,
   "record": "{\"id\": \"6c413d61-b72b-5cf2-9349-34ba54498719\", \"object\": \"page\", \"properties\": {\"Name\": {\"title\": [{\"plain_text\": \"October release notes\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"October release notes\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"title\"}, \"Problem\": {\"rich_text\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Keelwater's October release notes detail incremental improvements to claims processing workflows, including faster document upload speeds and enhanced error logging for user troubleshooting.\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Keelwater's October release notes detail incremental improvements to claims processing workflows, including faster document upload speeds and enhanced error logging for user troubleshooting.\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"ri"
  },
  {
   "source": "notion",
   "id": "3725e3b1-1ae8-55a3-9286-7db8d9b8fbd5",
   "similarity": 0.051,
   "record": "{\"id\": \"3725e3b1-1ae8-55a3-9286-7db8d9b8fbd5\", \"object\": \"page\", \"properties\": {\"Name\": {\"title\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Task overview\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Task overview\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"title\"}, \"Problem\": {\"rich_text\": [{\"plain_text\": \"A centralized dashboard in Keelwater that displays all active, pending, and completed tasks related to claims processing, helping users track progress and prioritize work without switching contexts.\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"A centralized dashboard in Keelwater that displays all active, pending, and completed tasks related to claims processing, helping users track progress and prioritize work without switching contexts.\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"ri"

 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked Shortcut story 4127, 'Bulk upload documents to a claim,' which is marked completed (2026-10-06) and explicitly states 'Users can now upload multiple documents at once to a claim in Keelwater, streamlining the process and reducing manual effort for claims handlers.' This directly solves the same core problem as the opportunity statement—handlers forced to upload documents one at a time. The other similar items (claim information display, task list improvements, task overview dashboard, and October release notes) are unrelated or only tangentially relevant. Because a shipped story solves the identical problem, the duplicate check fails.", "verdict": "fail"}
